title: Self-Mutating Architecture Linter & Zero-OS-Dependency Core

claims.assertion: Static architectural boundary verification must isolate domain core crates from OS runtime dependencies and plant synthetic violations of every boundary rule in a temporary workspace copy prior to production scanning, guaranteeing that detection rules never quietly decay.

distilled_learning: agent-desktop enforces a strict 400-LOC cap per file, zero inline // comments, and complete decoupling between crates/core and OS platform crates (windows, macos, linux). Its check_architecture.py script lexes source tokens into placeholders and runs a self-test by injecting synthetic violations into a temporary copy before scanning the repository. If any rule fails to detect its planted violation, CI immediately fails, providing infallible immunity against architectural regression.
